review.rationale: The locked Asteron artifact establishes clear hierarchy, distinctive brand language, coherent evidence-oriented information architecture, responsive layouts without overflow, keyboard-accessible core interactions, and complete functional-equivalence checks. Remaining polish opportunities are non-blocking and do not reduce any critical dimension below 90.

dimensionFindings.visualHierarchy: Strong hero-to-route framing and consistently legible section hierarchy across all three viewports.
dimensionFindings.typography: Clear hierarchy and readable body copy; small mono labels are intentionally restrained and remain the principal typography limitation.
dimensionFindings.layoutSpacing: Consistent container, section, and card rhythm; tablet and mobile collapse cleanly without horizontal overflow.
dimensionFindings.componentQuality: Route rail, evidence slips, ledgers, boundary list, navigation and evaluation form form a coherent component language.
dimensionFindings.uxClarity: Outcome-first framing, five-stage route and bounded evaluation make the intended user journey explicit.
dimensionFindings.interactionPolish: Menu, details, anchor focus and evaluation feedback work correctly; static prototype scope limits richer state polish.
dimensionFindings.responsiveExecution: 390px, 820px and 1440px renders preserve hierarchy and eliminate horizontal overflow; mobile navigation switches correctly.
dimensionFindings.brandDistinction: Asteron has a recognizable field/bone/brass visual system and evidence-led operating language rather than generic SaaS styling.
dimensionFindings.accessibility: Landmarks, labels, skip link, visible focus, keyboard behavior, aria-live feedback, reduced-motion support and spot-checked contrast pass.
dimensionFindings.statesAndFeedback: Menu expanded state, details open state, form validation and local success status are explicit; broader application states are outside this static artifact.
